name: filter-polish-609deba0-a
description: Полировка, часть 4 (ошибка 609deba0), группа A + C1. Онбординг → карта (C1: у типизированной мысли «+» зоны фокуса открывает МЕНЮ «Новый отбор типа мысли» / «Новый отбор вне типа» (спека df84de22), затем диалог отбора — создание и правка) → «Структуры мыслей» (A1 нет «Выборки» у типа, A2 отмена возвращает «Список», A3 неявное значение триады, A4 двойной клик по дате в календаре). Запуск: node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.filter-polish-609deba0-a.scenario.json --out .tmp/etn-609deba0-a/out

steps.name: c1-seed-typed-home
steps.eval: (async () => { const nid='{{networkId}}'; const type=await window.etn.types.createThoughtType(nid, { name: 'Тип стенда C1' }); const cur=await window.etn.thoughts.get(nid, '{{homeId}}'); await window.etn.thoughts.update(nid, '{{homeId}}', { type_id: type.id }, cur.version); window.__c1 = { typeId: type.id, viewId: null }; return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: c1-focus-home
steps.eval: (async () => { const el=document.querySelector('[data-id="{{homeId}}"] .cloud') || document.querySelector('.canvas-focus-row .cloud'); if(!el) return 'no-cloud'; el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: c1-add-enabled
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('.canvas-filter-strip-add'); return b !== null && b.disabled === false; })()

steps.name: c1-pick-type-view
steps.eval: (() => { const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item')].find(e=>(e.textContent||'').includes('Новый отбор типа мысли')); if(!it) return 'no-item'; it.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: c1-create-editor
steps.probe: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('.view-editor-body'); return b !== null && b.querySelector('.ft-group') !== null; })()

steps.name: c1-close-dialog-dismiss
c1-seed-view
steps.eval: (async () => { const nid='{{networkId}}'; const def=JSON.stringify({ version: 1, filter: { entity: { kind: 'id' }, operator: 'eq', value: '{{thoughtId}}' } }); const v=await window.etn.thoughtTypeViews.create(nid, window.__c1.typeId, { name: 'Отбор стенда C1', definition: def }); window.__c1.viewId=v.id; return v.id ? 'ok' : 'no'; })()

steps.name: c1-view-button
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('.canvas-filter-strip-btn[data-view-id="'+window.__c1.viewId+'"]'); return b !== null && b.disabled === false; })()

steps.name: c1-open-view-menu
steps.eval: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('.canvas-filter-strip-btn[data-view-id="'+window.__c1.viewId+'"]'); const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:r.left+5,clientY:r.top+5})); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: c1-click-edit
steps.eval: (() => { const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item')].find(e=>(e.textContent||'').includes('Изменить отбор')); if(!it) return 'no-item'; it.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: c1-edit-editor
steps.probe: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('.view-editor-body'); return b !== null && b.querySelector('.ft-group') !== null; })()

steps.name: c1-close-edit-dismiss
widen-window
steps.eval: (() => { window.resizeTo(1900, 1000); return window.innerWidth; })()

steps.name: panel-widen-drag
steps.eval: (async () => { const s = document.querySelector('.st-splitter'); const pan = document.querySelector('.st-filter'); if (!s || !pan) return 'no-splitter'; const orig = Element.prototype.setPointerCapture; Element.prototype.setPointerCapture = function () {}; const r = s.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = Math.round(r.left + 200); const y = Math.round(r.top + r.height / 2); const base = { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', isPrimary: true, button: 0, buttons: 1, clientX: x, clientY: y }; s.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', base)); for (let k = 1; k <= 6; k += 1) s.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', Object.assign({}, base, { clientY: y + 60 * k }))); s.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', Object.assign({}, base, { buttons: 0, clientY: y + 360 }))); Element.prototype.setPointerCapture = orig; await new Promise(r2 => setTimeout(r2, 250)); return Math.round(pan.getBoundingClientRect().height); })()

steps.name: a1-add-condition
steps.eval: (() => { const g=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-group[data-path=""]'); const b=g && g.querySelector('.ft-add-condition'); if(!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a1-pick-type
steps.eval: (async () => { document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="0"] .ft-row__what').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const it=document.querySelector('.ft-choice__item[data-key="type"]'); if(!it) return 'no-item'; it.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a1-pick-hierarchy
steps.eval: (async () => { const row=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="0"]'); row.querySelector('.ft-row__op').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const it=document.querySelector('.ft-choice__item[data-key="in_hierarchy"]'); if(!it) return 'no-op'; it.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a1-list-cards
steps.probe: (() => { const e=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="0"] .fv-entity'); return e !== null && e.dataset.entityKind === 'thought-types'; })()

steps.name: a3-pick-id
steps.eval: (async () => { document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="0"] .ft-row__what').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const it=document.querySelector('.ft-choice__item[data-key="id"]'); if(!it) return 'no-item'; it.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a3-issue-shown
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="0"]'); return r.dataset.severity === 'error' && (r.querySelector('.ft-issue__text')?.textContent||'').includes('не задано значение условия'); })()

steps.name: a3-pick-active
steps.eval: (async () => { document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="0"] .ft-row__what').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const it=document.querySelector('.ft-choice__item[data-key="active"]'); if(!it) return 'no-item'; it.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a3-issue-gone
steps.probe: (() => { const r=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="0"]'); return r.dataset.severity === undefined && r.querySelector('.fv-triad') !== null; })()

steps.name: a3-triad-value
steps.probe: (() => { const r=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="0"]'); const yes=[...r.querySelectorAll('.fv-triad button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='да'); return yes?.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true'; })()

steps.name: a2-add-condition
steps.eval: (() => { const g=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-group[data-path=""]'); const b=g && g.querySelector('.ft-add-condition'); if(!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a2-pick-link
steps.eval: (async () => { document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="1"] .ft-row__what').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ft-choice__item')].find(e=>(e.textContent||'').includes('Связь стенда')); if(!it) return 'no-item'; it.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a2-pick-in
steps.eval: (async () => { const row=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="1"]'); row.querySelector('.ft-row__op').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const it=document.querySelector('.ft-choice__item[data-key="in"]'); if(!it) return 'no-op'; it.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a2-mode-list-active
steps.probe: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="1"]'); const b=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fq-mode button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Список'); return b?.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true'; })()

steps.name: a2-open-subquery
steps.eval: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="1"]'); const b=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fq-mode button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Выборка'); if(!b) return 'no-btn'; b.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a2-cancel
steps.eval: (async () => { const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-backdrop button')]; const b=[...btns].reverse().find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Отмена'); if(!b) return 'no-cancel'; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a2-list-back
steps.probe: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="1"]'); const b=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fq-mode button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Список'); return b?.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' && row.querySelector('.fv') !== null && row.querySelector('.fq-chip') === null; })()

steps.name: a4-add-condition
steps.eval: (() => { const g=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-group[data-path=""]'); const b=g && g.querySelector('.ft-add-condition'); if(!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a4-pick-date
steps.eval: (async () => { document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="2"] .ft-row__what').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const menus=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ft-choice')]; const last=menus[menus.length-1]; const hit=last.querySelector('.ft-choice__item[data-key="created_at"]'); if(!hit) return 'no-item'; hit.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)); return (document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="2"] .ft-row__what')||{}).textContent||'none'; })()

steps.name: a4-to-exact
steps.eval: (() => { const s=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="2"] .fv-date__anchor'); s.value='exact'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a4-open-calendar
steps.eval: (async () => { const b=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="2"] .date-field-pick'); if(!b) return 'no-btn'; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); return document.querySelector('.dpd')!==null ? 'dpd' : 'none'; })()

steps.name: a4-value-set
steps.probe: (() => { const i=document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="2"] .date-field-input'); return i !== null && i.value.length === 10 && i.value[4] === '-' && i.value[7] === '-'; })()

steps.name: switch-to-dark
steps.eval: (() => { document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'dark'; return document.documentElement.dataset.theme; })()

steps.name: dark-a1-no-subquery-switch
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="0"]'); return row !== null && row.querySelector('.fq-mode') === null; })()

steps.name: dark-a2-mode-list-active
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row[data-path="1"]'); const m = row && row.querySelector('.fq-mode'); if (!m) return false; const b = m.querySelector('button'); return b !== null && (b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' || b.classList.contains('ui-btn--active')); })()
